lessons.titleZh: 避免情感紐帶逐漸變弱

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Regular calls keep the emotional thread from wearing thin.

brief.meaningEn: In the pattern keep the emotional thread from wearing thin, prevent an emotional connection from gradually weakening.
brief.meaningZh: 在 keep...from... 結構中，避免情感紐帶逐漸變弱。
brief.grammar: keep + the emotional thread + from + wearing thin; the marked fragment needs keep before it to express prevention
brief.boundaryZh: 來源標記只截取 emotional thread from wearing thin，完整結構是 keep...from...，意思是防止變弱，不是已變弱。thread 是情感連繫的創意比喻。
brief.misconceptionZh: 來源標記只截取 emotional thread from wearing thin，完整結構是 keep...from...，意思是防止變弱，不是已變弱。thread 是情感連繫的創意比喻。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「避免情感紐帶逐漸變弱」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: The guide glosses the highlighted fragment as a connection gradually weakening. Its actual reference sentence says Regular calls keep the emotional thread from wearing thin, so the full clause expresses preventing that weakening. New models preserve the preventive grammar rather than treating the fragment as a standalone idiom.

listening.en: Regular calls help the siblings keep the emotional thread from wearing thin while they live far apart.
listening.zh: 兄弟姊妹住得遠時，定期通話幫他們避免情感紐帶逐漸變弱。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 通話有助維持連繫，避免逐漸疏遠。
通話正令關係變弱，句子在批評聯絡。
他們的情感已完全消失，沒有任何連繫。
只要沒有爭執，即使很少交流也已足以證明一直親近。

listening.explanationZh: keep...from wearing thin 是避免變弱，不是造成變弱或已完全失去連繫。

reply.promptEn: Why do the siblings make time for calls while living apart?
reply.promptZh: 兄弟姊妹分開居住時，為甚麼抽時間通話？

options.en: The calls help keep the emotional thread from wearing thin.
options.zh: 通話有助避免情感紐帶逐漸變弱。

options.en: They want to stay involved in each other’s lives.
options.zh: 他們想繼續參與彼此生活。

options.en: Regular conversations make it easier to notice when someone needs support.
options.zh: 定期交談更容易讓人察覺誰需要支持。

options.en: Sharing ordinary news helps them feel less distant.
options.zh: 分享平常消息，幫他們減少距離感。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 住得遠的家人安排真誠交談，希望維持親近，防止日漸疏離。哪句最準確？

options.en: Their calls help keep the emotional thread from wearing thin.
options.zh: 通話有助避免他們的情感紐帶逐漸變弱。

options.en: Their calls cause the emotional connection to weaken.
options.zh: 他們的通話導致情感連繫變弱。

options.en: Their connection has already disappeared completely before they make any calls.
options.zh: 通話之前，他們的連繫已完全消失。

scene.explanationZh: 情境談維持及防止，與造成變弱或斷言已完全消失不同。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個理解不符合 keep the emotional thread from wearing thin？

options.en: 用有意義交流減少逐漸疏遠的風險。
keep...from 表示使連繫變弱，而非防止。
from 後用 wearing，完整句要有前面的 keep。

contrast.explanationZh: keep something from doing something 是防止，不是促使；這裏是避免紐帶變薄。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「我們住得遠，現在只傳行程訊息；我想重新聽聽彼此真實近況。」哪個回應最配合維持情感連結的目的？

options.en: Let us keep the emotional thread from wearing thin by setting aside a little time to listen to each other.
options.zh: 我們抽一點時間聆聽彼此，避免情感紐帶逐漸變弱吧。

options.en: Let us count reactions on old photos instead of making space for personal replies.
options.zh: 我們數數舊照片的反應，不用騰出個人回應空間。

options.en: Postpone personal conversation until we both have a whole weekend free.
options.zh: 等大家都有整個週末空閒，才談個人近況。

dialogue.explanationZh: 朋友想恢復真實交流，簡短而有聆聽的聯絡直接配合；數反應或一定等完整週末，未回應現在維繫的需要。

speaking.en: Short messages about ordinary days help keep the emotional thread from wearing thin between our regular calls.
speaking.zh: 定期通話之間，關於平常日子的簡短訊息有助避免情感紐帶逐漸變弱。
speaking.promptZh: 你想描述定期交流的維繫作用，保留句中 keep the。先聽，再說一句。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：合唱團畢業成員沒有常見面，仍每月分享舊演出錄音與新練習片段，認真回應彼此，希望保持共同回憶與連結。用一至兩句英文說明目的。

examples.en: Sharing recordings helps the former choir members keep the emotional thread from wearing thin. They respond to one another’s memories and new practice clips.
examples.zh: 分享錄音幫以前合唱團成員避免情感紐帶逐漸變弱。他們回應彼此回憶與新練習片段。

examples.en: The former singers make time to share music so they can keep the emotional thread from wearing thin after graduation.
examples.zh: 以前的歌手畢業後仍抽時間分享音樂，避免情感紐帶逐漸變弱。

writing.selfCheckZh: 保留 keep...from 的防止意思，以共同音樂和認真回應支持維繫，而非只報上傳次數。

takeaways.en: Shared conversations keep the emotional thread from wearing thin.
takeaways.zh: 彼此交談能避免情感紐帶逐漸變弱。

takeaways.en: We make time to listen and keep the emotional thread from wearing thin.
takeaways.zh: 我們抽時間聆聽，避免情感紐帶逐漸變弱。
